titulo: Word formation: compostos, prefixos e sufixos: Sufixos

aula.titulo: Word formation: compostos, prefixos e sufixos
aula.objetivo: Understand and form German words by compounding (Haustürschlüssel), verb prefixes (be-, ent-, er-, ver-, zer-; separable and inseparable) and suffixes (-ung, -heit, -keit, -schaft, -lich, -ig, -bar, -los), in order to work out the meaning of new words.

blocos.explicacao: STEP 1: SUFFIXES show the type of word and the gender. STEP 2: FEMININE nouns: «-UNG» (die Wohnung, die Meinung), «-HEIT» and «-KEIT» (die Freiheit, die Möglichkeit), «-SCHAFT» (die Freundschaft), «-TION» (die Information). STEP 3: nouns for PEOPLE: «-ER» (der Lehrer), «-IN» (die Lehrerin). STEP 4: DIMINUTIVES: «-CHEN» and «-LEIN» (always neuter): «das Mädchen», «das Büchlein». STEP 5: ADJECTIVES: «-LICH» (freundlich, like English "-ly"), «-IG» (ruhig), «-BAR» (lösbar, like "-able"), «-LOS» (arbeitslos, like "-less"), «-VOLL» (sinnvoll, like "-ful"), «-ISCH» (typisch, like "-ic"), and the prefix «UN-» (negation): «unmöglich». STEP 6: with these rules, you can work out the gender and meaning of new words.

tabela.example: freundlich, ruhig, lösbar, arbeitslos, sinnvoll, typisch, unmöglich

blocos.titulo: Wortbildung im Deutschkurs / Word formation in the German course
blocos.contexto: A teacher and two students play with words.

linhas.ru: — Heute sprechen wir über Wortbildung. Wer kennt ein langes Wort?
linhas.en: — Today we are talking about word formation. Who knows a long word?
linhas.audio: Heute sprechen wir über Wortbildung. Wer kennt ein langes Wort?

linhas.ru: — Der Schlüssel, der zur Haustür gehört.
linhas.en: — The key that belongs to the front door of the house.
linhas.audio: Der Schlüssel, der zur Haustür gehört.

linhas.ru: — Und welchen Artikel hat das Wort?
linhas.en: — And what article does the word have?
linhas.audio: Und welchen Artikel hat das Wort?

linhas.ru: — Den Artikel vom letzten Wort: „der Schlüssel", also „der Haustürschlüssel".
linhas.en: — The article of the last word: «der Schlüssel», so «der Haustürschlüssel».
linhas.audio: Den Artikel vom letzten Wort: „der Schlüssel", also „der Haustürschlüssel".

linhas.ru: — Sehr gut! Und das Substantiv zu „möglich"?
linhas.en: — Very good! And the noun for «möglich»?
linhas.audio: Sehr gut! Und das Substantiv zu „möglich"?

itens.enunciado: What is the article of Handtasche (Hand + Tasche)? (der, die, das)
What is the article of Kinderzimmer? (der, die, das)
What is the article of Haustür? (der, die, das)
What does Gift mean? (gift, poison)
What does bekommen mean? (to get, to become)
Which word means skirt, the piece of clothing?
itens.explicacao: Rock means skirt in this use: der Rock. Rente means retirement pension or a regular income, depending on the context.

itens.enunciado: Which suffix marks “without”?
itens.explicacao: The suffix -los can indicate the absence of something, as in arbeitslos, without work. -bar usually expresses possibility, as in something that can be done.

itens.enunciado: Build the compound word with the article: die Hand + die Tasche =
Build the compound word with the article: der Winter + die Jacke =
Build the compound word with the article: die Arbeit + die Zeit =
Build the compound word with the article: der Geburtstag + das Geschenk =
Build the compound word with the article: die Küche + der Tisch =
Build the compound word with the article: der Zahn + der Arzt =
Form the word asked for: wohnen → die ___ (-ung)
itens.explicacao: From wohnen, the noun Wohnung is formed. The stem wohn- takes -ung, and the noun is written with a capital letter.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: verkaufen → the man who sells: der ___ (-er); the woman: die Verkäuferin
itens.explicacao: The man who sells is der Verkäufer. The formation adds -er and changes au to äu; the prefix ver- is kept.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: verkaufen → the man who sells: der Verkäufer (-er); the woman: die ___
itens.explicacao: The feminine of Verkäufer is Verkäuferin, with -in. The article die is already written before the gap.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: krank → die ___ (-heit)
itens.explicacao: Krank takes the suffix -heit and forms the feminine noun Krankheit, illness. It is written with a capital letter.

itens.enunciado: Form the word asked for: die Arbeit → “without work”: ___ (-los)
itens.explicacao: Arbeitslos is formed with Arbeit, the linking element -s- and the suffix -los. As an adjective in the use asked for, it is written in lower case.

itens.enunciado: Fill in the verb that means to receive, not to become: Ich ___ zu Weihnachten einen Pullover.
itens.explicacao: Bekommen means to receive: Ich bekomme zu Weihnachten einen Pullover. Werden does not mean to receive; it can mean to become or work as an auxiliary in other structures.

itens.enunciado: Choose the word for a can of tomatoes: Ich kaufe eine ___ Tomaten.
itens.explicacao: Eine Dose Tomaten means a can of tomatoes. Dosis means dose, for example of a medicine, not the container asked for.

itens.enunciado: The warning means Careful! This is poison. Fill in: Vorsicht! Das ist ___!
itens.explicacao: Gift means poison. Geschenk means gift or present; the task makes clear that the warning refers to a poisonous substance.
